title: CASCADE Replication Package
description: Replication package for 'CASCADE: How Agent Failures Propagate in LLM Multi-Agent Systems—A Survey and Taxonomy' (submitted to Artificial Intelligence Review). Contains the propagation codebook (v1.0, v1.1, v1.2), 177 non-overlapping condensed execution traces adapted from MAST-Data (CC BY 4.0), the coder instructions, the raw annotations of three coders, the consensus annotations, and the analysis and figure scripts.
